universal_guidelines: ALWAYS use the Sidebar component on every authenticated page.
Ensure consistent padding (p-6 or p-8) across all main content areas.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) for darkest text.
Interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50).
Use 'lucide-react' icons with stroke-width=1.5 for a refined look.
Data tables should not have vertical borders, only horizontal 'border-b'.
